title: centrolepis pulvinata
intro: Centrolepis pulvinata, commonly known as the New Zealand button grass, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the sedge family, Cyperaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Centrolepis pulvinata include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The health benefits of Centrolepis pulvinata include its potential to reduce oxidative stress, improve insulin sensitivity, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
